{{Top}}
'''Jedi chapter houses''' were outposts of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] established in various places across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]]<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> and [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]].<ref name="Aleen">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|jediwatch/13425_1.html|Gotal Standoff Ends Violently}}</ref> The [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]] also operated chapter houses on [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]].<ref name="C&CW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The houses were supervized by the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]],<ref name="TJP" /> and were used as [[Jedi academy|Jedi academies]]. After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], most [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] chapter houses in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] were destroyed by [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] fanatics. However, the [[Jedi chapter house (Rhinnal)|chapter house]] located on Rhinnal was spared, and continued to serve as a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical treatment facility]].<ref name="C&CW" />
